{{Quote|With the Tof resistance funding our mission, money is not a concern.|Domina Tagge|<ref name="SW108" />}}
The '''Tof resistance''' was a resistance movement which arose after the defeat of the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] in the [[Battle of Saijo|battle]] of [[Saijo]]. The Tof resistance opposed the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
===End of the Tof invasion===
{{Quote|The Mandalorians and the Nagai will have to understand. New Republic forces are stretched far too thin as it is. The ''Tof'' threat&hellip; is&hellip;|Leia Organa, shortly before the attempt on her life|<ref name="SW108" />}}
[[File:Tof_assassin_1.jpg|thumb|left|175px|A [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] attempting to kill [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Noquivzor]]]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] were [[Battle of Saijo|defeated]] on [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] and the leader of their invasion force, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sereno]], was forced to surrender.<ref name="SW107" /> After the conclusion of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the Tofs retreated to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Tof (planet)|Tof]], located in a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that they called [[Firefist]]. Despite this forced retreat however, the bulk of the Tof [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] was able to return home.<ref name="TUR" />

While the Tofs were defeated, the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] had gained new allies in their efforts to reclaim their home [[Planet/Legends|planet]], which was still held by the Tofs.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The [[Nagai expeditionary force|Nagai fleet]] soon departed to fight the Tofs on [[Nagi/Legends|Nagi]], with help from [[Fenn Shysa]]'s [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]].<ref name="Gamer 1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref> The Nagai and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] liberated Nagi and put the Tofs in an entirely new position&mdash;on the defensive.<ref name="TUR" />

===After the Tof defeat===
{{Quote|Take my would-be assassin to a holding cell. And divert any military forces we can spare to support the Mandalorians' battle with the Tof.|Leia Organa, shortly after the attempt on her life|<ref name="SW108" />}}
[[File:Tof_assassin_2.jpg|thumb|right|225px|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] arresting the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]]]
In the wake of their defeat on Saijo, the Tofs organized a resistance movement to fight the Nagai and the Mandalorians. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|forces]] were too preoccupied with their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to divert any military forces to support the Nagai and the Mandalorians in their campaign against the Tofs. That changed after a Tof [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] attempted to kill [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Noquivzor]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Admitting that the Tof threat was real, the New Republic finally agreed to divert some of its military forces to fight the Tofs.<ref name="SW108" />

Meanwhile, [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] allied herself with the Tof resistance. The Tofs funded her [[Mission to retrieve the Great Life Jewels|mission]] to retrieve the [[Great Life Jewels]], two [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] that could create a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Crimson Forever]] if they were separated. Both Tagge and the Tof resistance wanted to use the gems' deadly powers in order to destroy the New Republic. Their plans were eventually foiled by a New Republic team sent to recover the Great Life Jewels, which had been stored aboard a [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Crimson Forever)|derelict]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] set adrift in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="SW108" />
